# EventPro by Vendibook

> Marketplace to book food trucks, caterers, mobile bartenders, private chefs, and dessert pros for events — search by date, time, and location with real-time availability and secure checkout.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and book event services by date, time, and location.
- [Browse](/browse): Browse all available packages with filters.
- [Discover](/discover): Swipe-style discovery of available packages.
- [Become an Event Pro](/become-a-pro): Sign up to list services and accept bookings.
- [Learn Hub](/learn): How EventPro works for bookers and pros.
- [For Event Pros](/learn/event-pros): Guide for vendors getting started.
- [Blog](/blog): Event planning tips and Event Pro insights.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers about bookings, cancellations, refunds, and payouts.
- [Support](/support): Help with bookings, refunds, and account access.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the EventPro team.

## Optional

- [Cancellation Policy](/cancellation): Flexible / Standard / Strict refund tiers.
